integrity: Analytical proof contains the universal claims; an attached independently-executable checker verifies algebraic identities and independent numerical integrals. Numerical sampling is corroboration rather than proof. No external/independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Real affine projectors on the uniformly measured two-sphere with one positive atom; no uniqueness or exact algebraic value is proved for the global switching weight, and no extension to multiple atoms or higher-degree spaces. The polynomial critical-point recipe gives exact values for each fixed weight but is not a closed radical formula. Earlier equivalent literature cannot be excluded.
title: Exact one-atom spherical affine projection norm and separation of local and global norming transitions
